items.headline: Nebraska's jab at Ohio State's 'THE' leads top Week 12 CFB trolls
items.description: Nebraska deployed a simple but effective troll that poked fun at its opponent's propensity to emphasize the "the" in "The Ohio State University."

items.headline: Richter throws TD pass to Dabbs, Griffith kicks 4 FGs for Toledo in 19-0 win over BGSU
items.description: — John Alan Richter threw a 35-yard touchdown pass to Adjatay Dabbs, senior Reice Griffith kicked a career-high four field goals and Toledo beat Bowling Green 19-0 on Friday night for the Rockets' fifth consecutive win.

items.headline: Long-distance touchdowns spark Toledo in 24-0 win over UMass
items.description: — Connor Walendzak scored on a 69-yard touchdown run, Nicholas Thompson returned an interception 62 yards for a touchdown, and Toledo defeated Massachusetts 24-0 on Wednesday night.
